prop.name: text
prop.help: Static display text. Overridden when bind_text is active.

prop.name: long_mode
prop.help: Overflow behaviour when text exceeds the widget width ([D-19]). clip hard-clips at the bounds; dots truncates with an ellipsis; scroll and scroll_circular marquee the text. wrap is not offered — U8G2GL labels are single-line, so a user arriving from LVGL Pro will meet this omission deliberately rather than find it missing silently.

prop.name: scroll_px_per_sec
prop.help: Marquee scroll speed in pixels per second. Meaningless unless long_mode is scroll or scroll_circular.

prop.name: initial_delay_ms
prop.help: Initial pause delay in milliseconds before scrolling starts. Meaningless unless long_mode is scroll or scroll_circular.

prop.name: static_dwell_ms
prop.help: Dwell duration in milliseconds for text that fits within bounds before signalling completion. Meaningless unless long_mode is scroll or scroll_circular.
